description: This Java source file defines the class UrlRegexpTransform, which implements the TemplateTransformModel interface for FreeMarker templates. It provides functionality to transform URLs based on regular expressions for SEO optimization and URL rewriting within the OFBiz framework. The class includes methods for handling URL encoding, matching and replacing URL patterns, and integrating with web request/response objects for dynamic URL generation and redirection.
